scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the weak-Allee equation, the definition of the cooperation parameter, the addition of the treatment destruction term, and the stated sufficient global-stability condition. The relevant source page was visually inspected. A primary tumor-Allee paper was inspected for broader context. The bundled symbolic checker independently replays the exact maximization and phase classification. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding concerns sustained constant treatment in the deterministic single-clone weak-Allee equation. It does not determine an optimal finite-duration treatment schedule, does not imply permanent eradication after treatment is stopped, and is not a clinical dosing recommendation.

title: A sharp constant-therapy eradication threshold for the weak-Allee cancer model
